Qualified Health, Truveta, and Epic Systems specifically address the 'governance' and 'notable non-VC' angles requested in the brief — Epic never raised institutional VC and Truveta is jointly owned by 17 US health systems rather than a conventional VC-backed startup. Iodine Software (acquired by Waystar, Oct 2025), Memora Health (acquired by Commure, Dec 2024), and Xealth (acquired by Samsung, 2025) are marked status=acquired but retained since they operated as independent VC-backed clinical-AI companies for most of their life and their acquirers are directly relevant to the investor graph. IMPORTANT CAVEAT ON SOURCING METHOD: this session's WebSearch tool was already at its budget cap (200/200, exhausted by other agents in the same shared session) before I could issue a single query, and direct WebFetch of Google's search UI (google.com), Bing, and DuckDuckGo returned CAPTCHA/garbage pages. I worked around this by (1) fetching each company's own website directly (highest confidence, used for 'what', HQ, founders where available) and (2) fetching Google News RSS *search* URLs (news.google.com/rss/search?q=...), which reliably returned real aggregated article titles/dates/publishers/snippets even though the tool could not follow through to render most individual publisher pages (Google News redirect links mostly returned empty JS shells). Every funding figure in this file is backed by at least one such source and, where possible, a verbatim article headline as the quote. Numbers that could not be corroborated by a clear title/snippet (e.g., a Cohere Health '$450M round with Nvidia and Salesforce', a Xealth '2.7 trillion won' Samsung deal value) were deliberately dropped rather than guessed — see individual verification_notes. Investor round-attribution for Qualified Health's 9 named backers, and Truveta's 17 health-system co-owners, could not be resolved to individual named entities per round from available coverage; recorded as best-effort collective/unattributed entries with notes flagging the limitation. HQ city and founding year are missing (nulled/omitted, never guessed) for a number of companies (Abridge, Suki, DeepScribe, OpenEvidence, Commure, Iodine Software, Akasa, Cohere Health's Boston-vs-Portsmouth discrepancy, Infinitus, Assort Health, Innovaccer, Truveta's founding year, H1, Massive Bio, Carta Healthcare, Aiva Health, Fathom, KelaHealth, Glass Health) because no fetched source stated them explicitly, even though several are common industry knowledge — flagging for a future pass with working web search. Portfolio-page fetching was the most productive technique per the team lead's suggestion: Oak HC/FT's page surfaced Syllable, Town Hall Ventures' page surfaced Machinify, and Optum Ventures' page surfaced Humata Health — all three added as new records with the portfolio page itself as a source for the investor edge. SmarterDx and Cofactor AI were added from the team lead's named URL list and a Google News RSS lookup respectively. The shared WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200, used by other teammates) before I made a single search call, and stayed exhausted for the rest of the session — team-lead confirmed it could not be raised.
